fusions.name: Webbed Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps a webbed palm forward, splashing a cone 3 tiles deep for 4 water damage with a 50% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plucked Clean
fusions.desc: Plucks every affliction off the target at once for 18 damage, adding 1.5 times the afflictions' remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Backhand Flick
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Dabbler's Paddle
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8%, and from gold your mana recovers 25% faster.
